method.reference: Exact expectation over all 50! uniformly random rankings of each fixed candidate pool; no API calls or simulated approximation for expected metrics
method.top_5_formula: mean over k=1..5 of sum_i[(t_min/t_i) * comb(n-i-1,k-1)/comb(n,k)], timings sorted ascending, i zero-based from 0..n-k
method.bootstrap_unit: resample 120 workload pairs with replacement; deterministic expected-Random value travels with same workload as Jev result
method.ci: percentile 2.5 and 97.5; unadjusted; conditional on candidate pool and Jev choices; workload dependence not modeled
method.artifact_policy: Observed random-42 result is retained unchanged; expected_random is a separately named analytical reference
